name: only-tdy
description: Capture tasks quickly, choose what matters today, and leave the rest in Backlog.

scripts.check:bundle: node --input-type=module --eval 'import { readdir, readFile } from "node:fs/promises"; import { gzipSync } from "node:zlib"; const html = await readFile("dist/index.html", "utf8"); const entryNames = [...html.matchAll(/(?:src|href)="[^"]*\/assets\/([^"]+\.js)"/g)].map((match) => match[1]); if (entryNames.length === 0) throw new Error("No initial JavaScript found."); const workerNames = (await readdir("dist/assets")).filter((name) => name.startsWith("workbox-window.") && name.endsWith(".js")); const names = [...new Set([...entryNames, ...workerNames])]; const buffers = await Promise.all(names.map((name) => readFile("dist/assets/" + name))); const bytes = buffers.reduce((total, buffer) => total + gzipSync(buffer).byteLength, 0); console.log("Initial JavaScript: " + bytes + " bytes gzip"); if (bytes > 102400) process.exit(1);'
